cwes.name: Uncaught Exception
cwes.description: Uncaught Exception occurs when security controls are improperly implemented or validated.
cwes.impact: May lead to data leakage, unauthorized access, service disruption, or system compromise.
prevention: Catch and handle all critical exceptions
Never expose stack traces to users
